valve_scope: fully open; stop at a closing command, do not invent closure transients
fluid_scope: primed, bubble-free, rigid constant-bore tubing; forward liquid flow only
inertia_source: rho * sum(L_i/A_i), known straight tubes only; excludes unknown component inertance
roughness_source: smooth-pipe assumption, not a measured roughness
transition_source: engineering 2000/4000 thresholds with cubic smooth blending, not measured transition
component_loss_source: Rh_loaded minus calculated laminar straight-tube resistance; lumped residual, not an identified valve curve
additional_component_K_source: not identified; disabled, zero does not prove no local nonlinear loss
material_relaxation_source: not identified; no invented Ecoflex relaxation constants
